items.detail_en: In the principal's office, with Director Chu Po-yang and Section Chief Hsieh Feng-lien.
items.detail_zh: 在校長室，由朱博揚主任、謝豐濂組長協助。

items.detail_en: The principal is away that day, so Director Chu Po-yang will be interviewed instead, in the principal's office. Two questions: 1) Why did you choose to lead a school? What is your philosophy of education? 2) Why do international connections and English learning matter so much for students?
items.detail_zh: 校長當天不在，改由朱博揚主任在校長室接受採訪。兩個問題：一、為何要擔任校長（教育理念）？二、為何推國際連結與英語教育對學生而言很重要？
items.note_en: For the Voices in Education series.
items.note_zh: 收錄於「教育之聲」專訪系列。

footnote_en: The principal is away on November 24, so Director Chu Po-yang will give the interview. The visit ends around 3:50 p.m., after the gratitude class. In the morning, Dom is at Lukang Elementary.
